title: Lightning and Sun Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Science Fact Graphic Tee, Weather Lover Gift
intro:
Brilliant blue lightning crosses a blazing orange Sun above bold lettering: Lightning Is Hotter Than the Surface of the Sun. Dramatic space artwork turns a surprising science fact into a vivid conversation starter for weather fans, physics enthusiasts, and science teachers.

THE FACT BEHIND THE DESIGN
The slogan compares lightning with the Sun’s visible surface. Lightning can heat the air around it to around 50,000°F, exceeding the temperature of the Sun’s surface.
